decisions.reason: Premium support builds directly on the firm's core round-the-clock expert support know-how and centralized service operations. That makes it easy to assimilate and refine from customer feedback, and it fits the agency-focused strategy.

The version management tool extends the firm's own in-house tool development, such as the security center and recovery manager. It draws on existing technical knowledge and reduces recurring operational work for customers.

The contract-creation tool for data processing agreements sits furthest from the firm's hosting core and depends on legal rather than technical knowledge. It is cheap to maintain and supports GDPR compliance for agency customers, so keeping it is marginally favoured despite weaker absorptive fit.

Scalable agency hosting is the flagship product and rests squarely on the firm's owned data center capacity and hosting expertise. This gives the firm strong ability to interpret early results and keep improving the product.
